svg.title: Dilation and curettage worked step by step, each step with the complication it causes and what to do: cervical preparation and infection prophylaxis, the paracervical block and cervical shock, mechanical dilation and cervical trauma, suction curettage with perforation and hemorrhage, then hematometra, retained products and Asherman's syndrome after the evacuation
